title: A Person to Watch Out For

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Tower of Luna towers so high that it seems to continue endlessly into the heavens. Even so, there are people willing to challenge those heights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
天へ向け無限に続くかに見えるほど高くそびえるルナの塔。
その遥か高みへ挑もうとする者たちの姿があった。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: So, here we'll find a clue to restoring your memories, huh... This is my first time here, but the tower is much taller than I could've ever imagined.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここにあなたの記憶の手がかりが……
初めて来たけど、
想像していたより
ずいぶんと高い塔だね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that just makes its exploration even more worth it. ...Oh my?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
探索しがいがあっていいじゃない。
……あら？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Where do you think you're going? The tower is this way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこに行くんですか？　
塔はこっちですよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I've just found an herb that can be used as an ingredient to brew a powerful tonic. I thought I could use it to try an experiment I'd never attempted before... you're up, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
強壮薬の原料になる
珍しい薬草を見つけたものだから。
これで
試したことのない実験ができると思って……
ね？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: What a shame. Still, the vegetation here is quite unusual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念。
それにしても
ここはずいぶんと変わった植生をしているのね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: There might be some interesting species inside the tower too, so I'm looking forward to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔の中も
面白い薬草がたくさんありそうで楽しみだわ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Mitsuki-san... I checked her identity when I heard from him she would be accompanying us on the expedition, but to find out she's part of that dangerous guild, Twilight Caravan... I really can't let my guard down here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミツキさん……
探索に同行すると聞いて身元を調べたけど、
あの要注意ギルド
【トワイライトキャラバン】の一員だし、
どうにも油断できないんだよな。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I've also heard rumors that she's taking exorbitant medical fees for medical treatment that barely qualifies as legal. I want to believe in her, since she's {0}-san's acquaintance, however...
text_block_list.orig_text:
グレーな医療行為で
法外な診察料を
取ってるって噂も聞こえてくるし。
{0}さんの知り合いだから信じたいけど……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: No, that's not a good enough reason. As a member of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, I must use this opportunity to determine whether she is a dangerous person or not.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
そんな理由じゃダメだよね。
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】団員として
危険人物かどうか、
この機会に見極めないと。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Quite a troubled face you have there, any reason why? Don't worry, I'll make sure finding clues to {0}'s memories is a top priority.
text_block_list.orig_text:
難しい顔してどうしたの？
大丈夫、
{0}君の記憶の手がかりを
最優先で探すから。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, that's clearly not something I'm worried over. More importantly, are you done collecting herbs? If you need some help, just ask. Ah, it's this herb, right...--
text_block_list.orig_text:
やだなあ、
そんな心配はしてませんよ。
それより
薬草はもういいんですか？
必要なら私も手伝います。
あっ、
この草ですよね──

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Please don't pick those up so carelessly. Their nectar is poisonous. Depending on how it is used, it can also be turned into a powerful poison.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うかつに採っちゃダメ。
汁に毒があるから。
使い方次第では
猛毒にもなるのよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: A powerful poison...
text_block_list.orig_text: 猛毒……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Do you perhaps... believe that I'm going to misuse it? Fear not. It is very easy to detect this kind of poison, I'd do a better job than that. Just kidding♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
ひょっとして
私が悪用すると思ってる？
安心して。
この毒は簡単に検出されちゃうの。
私ならもっとうまくやるわ。
なんてね♪

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: *sigh* As a member of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE, I'd appreciate it if you refrained from making jokes like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
そういう冗談は
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】団員である
私の前では遠慮してほしいですね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Somehow you seemed a little tense, Tomo-chan, so I thought I'd ease the atmosphere a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだかトモちゃんが緊張してるみたいだから
リラックスさせてあげようと思っただけよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: I'm not nervous at all.
text_block_list.orig_text: 私は緊張なんてしてませんよ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that's the case. There's no way a knight from the Royal Order of NIGHTMARE would be nervous about climbing a tower like this one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよね、
天下の【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】様が
こんな塔くらいで緊張するわけないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Of course. Our order trains every day for the sake of the citizens of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん。
私たちは
日々ランドソル市民のために
厳しい訓練をしていますから。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well then, as one of those frail citizens, I'll be relying on you without holding back, Tomo-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
それじゃあ、
ひ弱な一市民の私は
遠慮なく
トモちゃんを頼らせてもらうわ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go. I can already tell this is going to be a fun exploration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
行きましょう。
楽しい探索になりそうね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: There's more to that brazen attitude than meets the eye. She's no ordinary woman. No matter what, I cannot keep my guard down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの堂々たる立ち居振る舞い、
やっぱりただものじゃない。
油断しないようにしよう。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: If I somehow manage to grab this cat by the tail, I'll catch her myself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何か尻尾をつかんだら
私一人で捕まえないと……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yeah. You're right, let's go. Our primary objective is to find clues about your memories, {0}-san. We mustn't forget that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
ああ。
そうだね、
行こう。
一番の目的は
{0}さんの記憶の手がかりだもんね。
それを忘れちゃいけないよね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Tilting his head at Tomo’s words, {0} stepped into the tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモの言葉に首をかしげつつ、{0}は
塔の中へと足を踏み入れるのであった。
